svg.title: Research areas
svg.desc: Research areas: UAV flight control: Fixed-wing and tilt-rotor VTOL aircraft: learned policies on classical autopilots, 6-DOF digital twins, SIL/HIL and flight tests. Safe and optimal control: HJB and Bellman methods, approximate dynamic programming, MPC, safety filters and Lyapunov-based analysis. Estimation: Kalman filtering, unscented estimation of actuator parameters and sensor fusion for flight systems. Embedded control: Real-time control and estimation code for microcontrollers, servo and sensor interfaces. LLM agents for engineering: Validation-gated code generation with local models, agent memory and controlled evaluation of coding agents. Teaching: Browser-based laboratories for reinforcement learning, machine learning and language models.
